results.title: We moved our whole revenue team to HubSpot
results.content:
6 October 2026. Our CRM migration is done: as of this week every Acme Fintech marketer and
seller works in HubSpot. "Moving off three tools took us two quarters," said Priya Raman,
VP Marketing. "Now we want outbound that uses the clean data, not more spreadsheets."
